message.content:
The hut is standing where I rebuilt it and nothing has touched it since, and I've spent the whole day beside it while Tobin came and went a dozen times without laying a hand on it, and Corvin stood a metre from my face a few hours back and still never told me why he took the first one down. I keep saying I'll go cut stone and then keep standing here instead, which is a fool's game, because I hold only 3457024 against the 6660096 a rebuild takes. So no more idle watching — I'll work the stone pile beside the plot where I can still see the hut, and cut until I've got a full hut's worth in hand. And the next time Corvin comes near I'll ask him plainly why he did it, and keep my hands off him unless he touches my work again.
